summary: ABDM M2 (CRM as HIP) tested end-to-end. Backend: 45 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_abdm_m2_hip.py, all passing (one test-side assertion fixed). Covered: the 13 inbound /api/v3 callbacks return the right codes in under 3s and log to abdm_callbacks; 401 without Authorization, 400 for a wrong X-HIP-ID or X-HIU-ID; keyMaterial is stripped; a non-JSON body does not cause a 500. Patient-initiated linking: discover -> init (otp_sent, 6-digit otp_display) -> wrong OTP (attempts=1, still not linked) -> right OTP (care context linked via patient_initiated, otp_display removed). Consent notify GRANTED is stored. The health-information request builds and encrypts a bundle and writes abdm_transfers; the push gets 401 because no gateway token is cached while the proxy is down, which is expected. Outbound calls are logged with status 0 'ABDM unreachable via India proxy: ConnectTimeout' and nothing crashes. CRM APIs checked: RBAC (sales rep 403 on every endpoint), sync 404 / provider 403 / admin sweep, callbacks master-only, cron 401/200, from-qr (new record, no kyc downgrade, 4 bad-QR cases return 400), lookup, attach (other provider 404). Frontend: /abha (Scan ABHA QR dialog with live viewfinder, Records panel, counts, rows, consents, Sync now toast); Hospital Command Center ABHA column badge/Scan and the admit form scan button (admissions mocked with page.route because the test hospitals have no admissions); provider ledger Add extended service -> service-abha-scan opens the QR dialog; PatientDetail badge + per-patient panel, or 'No ABHA linked' + Scan. Found and fixed one 500 that blocked every PatientDetail page. Found several consent and security issues, listed below.

critical.issue: Inbound callbacks accept ANY Authorization value (e.g. 'Bearer x') on the public preview/prod URL. Anyone can post a forged GRANTED consent naming any care-context reference, then send a HI request with their own keyMaterial and dataPushUrl. The CRM then encrypts the FHIR bundle to the attacker's key and POSTs it to the attacker's URL: full health-record exfiltration. The test suite does exactly this to its own endpoint. Fix: verify the gateway JWT signature (ABDM gateway certs/JWKS) or a shared secret / mTLS from api.tratahealth.com; fetch or verify the consent artefact from ABDM instead of trusting the notify body; check the dataPushUrl.

For any dataPushUrl not on abdm.gov.in, push_data adds 'Authorization: Bearer <cached ABDM gateway token>' and posts to that arbitrary, caller-supplied URL. Combined with the issue above, this leaks the ABDM gateway session token to attackers. Send the ABDM token only to ABDM hosts, or to an allow-listed HIU host.

The date filter ends with `... ] or ccs`: when no care context falls inside the requested range, it falls back to sharing ALL consented contexts. Reproduced: consent and request range 2020, record dated 2026, and DS-TEST_probe-1 was still bundled and pushed. Also not enforced: consent hiTypes (consent was Prescription, a DischargeSummary was sent), consent permission.dateRange / dataEraseAt expiry, and whether the consent patient matches the care-context patient. Remove the `or ccs` fallback and filter by consent hi_types and permission range.

minor.issue: Took 42.8s with the proxy down. sync_patient awaits link_pending -> link_token_for -> hiecm_post (3 attempts plus backoff) inline. In the UI, 'Sync now' on PatientDetail gave no toast for 8s+ and is close to the ingress timeout. Spawn link_pending in the background and return {found,new} right away. The admin sweep has the same risk as the number of patients grows.

Not scoped by owner. Provider B got provider A's patient ABHA number/address/name for any patient_user_id (cross-tenant PII). Scope to the caller's own records, or to patients the provider has treated.

kyc_verified is not downgraded (correct), but unverified QR fields ($set name/gender/dob/abha_address/patient_user_id) overwrite an existing OTP-verified record. Verified name 'TEST_probe Verified Name' became the QR's name and still shows as verified. If kyc_verified is true, only fill missing fields.
Does not check that the requested care-context references belong to the requesting abhaAddress / patient reference. It also merges references from different patients under ccs[0]'s patient.
patient_user_id is not validated (any string is accepted and triggers a sync). Lookup happens before the role check, so a sales rep gets 404 for unknown ids (403 for real ones). Low impact.

FIXED by testing agent: _split_lab_rows(conn) ran after the `async with pool.acquire()` block had exited, so every admin PatientDetail returned 500 ('connection has been released back to the pool'). The call now runs inside the block. Pre-existing bug, but it blocked the ABHA badge/panel on PatientDetail.

integration_issues.issue: Picks the patient by fuzzy first-name substring (`p.name.includes(first)`), so 'Raj' also matches 'Rajesh' or 'Suraj'. It then silently POSTs /abdm/patients/attach, which links the ABHA to the wrong patient and shares that person's records to the wrong ABHA. Match on exact phone only, or ask the user to confirm when matching by name.

Sends the last 10 digits of customer_phone. If that does not match ^[6-9]\d{9}$ (bad or legacy phones), /records/from-qr returns 422 and the scan fails with an error toast. Send null when the pattern does not match.
No feedback for about 40s while the backend waits on the unreachable proxy (see backend minor issue).

action_items: CRITICAL: authenticate inbound /api/v3 callbacks (verify the ABDM gateway JWT, or a shared secret/mTLS from the Trata gateway) and do not trust consent-notify bodies blindly
CRITICAL: never send the ABDM gateway bearer token to a non-ABDM dataPushUrl
HIGH: remove the `or ccs` date-range fallback in do_hi_request; enforce consent hi_types, the permission dateRange/expiry and the patient match
Stop QR scans from overwriting OTP-verified fields
ServiceForm ABHA scan: exact phone match or explicit confirmation before attach
do_init: check that care contexts belong to the requesting ABHA
critical_code_review_comments: abdm_hip.inbound: the Authorization header is only checked for presence. Use real gateway auth (see action items).
abdm_hip.do_hi_request: consent artefact fields (hi_types, permission.dateRange, dataEraseAt) are stored but never enforced.
abdm_hip.link_requests: providers see OTPs for any patient with a care context at their facility, including references from other providers in the same link request.
abdm.save_record (qr_scan path) can reassign patient_user_id on an existing record from a QR scan, with no confirmation.
abdm_hip.py is 555 lines; collect_records SQL could move to its own module.

rca of the issue: PatientDetail 500: supabase_db.fetch_patient_detail -> _fetch_patient_associations built its return dict outside `async with pool.acquire() as conn`, then awaited _split_lab_rows(conn) on a released connection (asyncpg InterfaceError). Repro: GET /api/admin/patients/<any id> as admin while the lab-split tables are live. Fixed by computing lab_rows inside the block. HI over-sharing: the list-comprehension filter ends with `or ccs`, so an empty filtered list falls back to the full list.
